text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a powerful run!
The one conquering the Copa Republica Argentina is—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*...
...Shh...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...If I remember right, there are Senior-class
Umamusume running in this too... aren't there...?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I can actually do this...!
I'm in top shape...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: With this—

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Jordan! Yaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap! Jordan's on fire!!
Her stride can stretch out that far!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right!
Our friend is super strong!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to fall behind either!
Let's get hyped and crush this training!"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Aweeesooommmeeee!
JOOOORDAAAAN!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Haha...! 
You sure can yell pretty damn loud...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This ain't over yet!
I can still go higher than this!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna get way bigger!
I'm gonna run in that race, too! Uhm—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A-ri-ma Ki-nen!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So yeah, countin' on ya~. That's a super crazy GⅠ, right?

Following her bold declaration at the racetrack,
Tosen Jordan casually asked to enter the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I already declared it.
At this point, I have to, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I wanna look even cooler
in front of those guys, too.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
First, we must let your hooves
fully heal.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeeh~?! You've gotta be Jordaning me, right?!
No way my nails haven't healed yet~~~?!"

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: It's not something that heals that easily. Even so, it's clear she's been managing it properly over the past six months.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"At the very least, it won't get any worse.
If you keep up the recovery efforts, it will definitely heal completely."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...! Really?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even so, please do not let your guard down.
Trainer-san, please make sure you pay close attention
to caring for her hooves without negligence.
choice_data_list: Yes, since we're at it, I want to make a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Heheh... What's this?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Things are going pretty well, aren't they?
Now all that's left is for me to win the Arima Kinen, right?

One week since then.
A certain rumor had become the talk of the town among the Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
This year's Tiara route is seriously wild.
There's already someone aiming for the world stage, right?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If you're talking about the strongest active Umamusume right now,
it'd probably be one from the Tiara route...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"No way... 'Strongest active runner' is really pushing it. I mean, look,
those girls are running in the next Arima Kinen, too."

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
All those crowd-favorites are indeed
declaring their entry into the race...
This Arima Kinen might just be the clash to decide who's the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And tomorrow, meteors will fall...
This is gonna be one crazy match...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Well, that sounds hopeless...
Guess I'll let my mom know, too...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welcome☆ Delivery to Mars,
table for one right this way~♪
The boarding gate will be that tire over there~♪

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa!?
Stop, what are you planning to do to me!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Name the digits of pi!
3.1415926535... What comes next?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Your reaction time is way too slow! You'll never dodge an attack from the Turf Aliens like that, will ya!?
Alright, next Trainer! C'mon!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What is that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah. Less 'amazing', more 'stupid'.
I mean, she's totally nuts.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, every time I race,
I'm always first or second favorite... right?
...I just don't get it."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who couldn't solve it, go hit the tires!!
I'll lend you my custom hammer!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Eeeh...?

Is that... sledgehammer training?
It's effective for whole-body strength. Though I have no idea
why she's dragged someone else into it...
choice_data_list: Was there actually any thought behind your actions...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Is that a habit of yours?
You always tie everything back to training.
Is your brain okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way. Not at all.
I mean, it's Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Forget about that, focus, focus!
Focus on the Arima Kinen that I'm running in!
choice_data_list: The "Arima Kinen" is going to be a tough race.
I think the "Arima Kinen" will be a tough race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I get it, I get it. But we can totally do this, right?
You saw it too, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Look at how I ran in the Copa Republica Argentina!
Even against Senior-class rivals, I held my own."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I do check whether I can run or not, at least.
Look, even in the popularity vote—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
28th place as of right now! Isn't that crazy?!
And that's right after saying "I'm entering the race~" the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't everyone super hyped for me now?
Could 1st place on race day actually happen?"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Jordan! I picked the spot for the Arima after-party!
I'll send it to the group chat!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've managed to work things out so far, right?
In that case, don't we just gotta give it our all?

Tosen Jordan declares that
with total nonchalance.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Figuring out how to do your best is on you, though.
Well, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm just an idiot, after all.
So with that said, I'm counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at this! Look, look!
It's the entry list for the Arima Kinen, but...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, I've heard that dozens of times.
It's an amazing lineup, right?
...Oh, there's even some nostalgic names here."

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"This Tosen Jordan girl!
I'm pretty sure she made quite a splash in the Satsuki Sho, right?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, not the one from six months ago... I mean!
My favorite is gonna be in it!
It's this girl right here――
...One month remaining until the 'Arima Kinen'.
